svg.text: CVA6 FENCE.I Instruction Commit & Cache Tag Invalidation Waveform (Cycles 338 – 352)
FENCE.I commits at Cyc 343 after SW drains. Controller asserts flush_icache_o and full pipeline flushes; I-Cache enters FLUSH state (flush_en=1).

• Cyc 343: FENCE.I reaches head of commit_stage. Since NoStPending=1, fence_i_o asserts. Controller asserts flush_icache_o=1 and full pipeline flushes (IF/ID/EX). • Cyc 344: I-Cache transitions from READ to FLUSH (state 0). Tag invalidation counter (flush_cnt_q) starts incrementing from 0 to 255 (256 cycles) to clear all valid bits.
